overview: Despatch (1940): a small Taiwan Chamber of Commerce delegation holds a Manila sample fair of tea, camphor, and other goods; a memo notes Japanese military limits on releasing Taiwan's farm statistics.

subfiles.title: Despatch on the Manila Sample Fair of Taiwan Products
subfiles.about: Reports on a Taiwan Chamber of Commerce delegation that exhibited Taiwanese products at a sample fair in Manila during April and May 1940.
subfiles.summary: Warner reports a reduced Taiwan Chamber of Commerce delegation held a Manila sample fair of tea, camphor, and other goods, generating little business but useful experience.

subfiles.title: Memorandum on Restrictions Affecting Agricultural Reporting from Taiwan
subfiles.from: U.S. Department of State, Division of Far Eastern Affairs
subfiles.about: Summarizes Agricultural Attaché Owen L. Dawson’s report on Japanese military restrictions limiting access to agricultural information in Taiwan.
subfiles.summary: Memo: military restrictions limited Dawson's access to Taiwan agricultural statistics, suggesting reciprocal information access.

interest: Shows a 1940 Taiwan trade-promotion fair in Manila and Japanese military limits on Taiwan's agricultural data.
